Perfect! I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Changes Made

### Core Cycle Support (`src/cycles.js`)
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK = 'weekly'` constant
- Added weekly to supported cycles
- Set `MONTHS_PER_CHARGE[CYCLE.WEEK] = 12/52` for proper monthly cost calculation
- Updated `monthlyCents()` to round to nearest cent using `Math.round()` instead of `Math.floor()`
- Updated `nextCharge()` to handle weekly cycles with 7-day intervals

### CLI Updates (`bin/subtrack.js`)
- Updated usage to show `--every month|year|week`
- Added 'week' and 'weekly' mappings to the EVERY object
- Updated error message in `cycleFlag()`
- Added weekly to SHARE_PER_MONTH for total calculations
- Fixed total calculation to use proper rounding

### Export (`src/export.js`)
- Added weekly support with correct monthly cost calculation
- Changed from `Math.floor()` to `Math.round()` for consistent rounding

### Renewals Sorting (`src/renewals.js`)
- Fixed sorting to use actual dates instead of string comparison, ensuring chronological order

### Test Updates
- Updated yearly plan test expectation to reflect proper rounding

## Verification Results ✅

- **npm test**: 34 pass, 0 fail
- **Weekly add command**: ✅ Works with `--every week`
- **Mixed cycles**: ✅ Weekly, monthly, and yearly plans work together
- **Monthly cost calculation**: ✅ €59.90 weekly = €259.57/month (rounded correctly)
- **€12 weekly plan**: ✅ Shows €52.00/month
- **Rounding**: ✅ €100.06 yearly shows €8.34/month (not cut off to €8.33)
- **Renewals**: ✅ Meal kit shows on Oct 30 (7 days after Oct 23, 14 days after Oct 16, etc. from Oct 2 start)

The implementation is complete and all requirements are met!
